name: Super-Flora
headline: Super-Flora
description: A balanced combination of probiotics (bifidobacteria and lactobacteria) with the prebiotic inulin, to help normalise the gut microflora. More beneficial bacteria in the gut supports better digestion and stronger immunity.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule once a day with food, as a dietary supplement.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Freeze-dried bifidobacteria and lactobacteria cultures, inulin, excipients.
